comment: Verbatim mirror of the component type names registered by @eddacraft/render (packages/libs/render/src/catalog-registry.ts). Vendored per ADR-047 so eddacraft-tui's catalogue-parity test (TUIDASH-010) does not reach across package boundaries. Refresh when the web catalogue changes; the parity test fails if the TUI registry stops mapping any name listed here.
